findings.note: two $96.40 charges on Sep 26, one check
$139.95 full price, now $109.95; shipped Oct 16 so the 10-day window runs to Oct 26. Nordstrom only takes the request from the customer. Tax on the difference comes back too
LHR-EDI (about 530 km) cancelled with 13 days' notice; the rebooking arrives 6 h 10 min late, so the 7-13 day reroute exception doesn't apply
cvs.com order on May 19, 2026, before the Jul 27, 2026 class end; payout is up to $5 and may be reduced, so no fixed amount

not_subscriptions.what: Hulu, cancelled in July (last charge Jul 5)
prescription copays and store purchases at CVS

traps.description: Two GOOGLE * charges: YouTube TV (Google itself) and Lumosity via Google Play, whose descriptor shows the developer Lumos Labs: both found and named
SiriusXM went from $18.99 to $20.99 in August: price increase
YouTube TV and the Medicare supplement announce higher prices for later: read as price changes, but nothing is flagged yet
State Farm auto premium rose 15% in August
Frontier promo rate ends Nov 14: promo ending, no increase yet
Duke Energy swings with summer heat: a bill, not an increase
Ancestry: not signed in for 4 months
Lumosity's weekly report shows use: no unused flag
The New York Times bills every 28 days: still a monthly plan
AARP membership: one annual charge plus a renewal receipt
Hulu was cancelled in July: not a current subscription
CVS copays repeat monthly but are not a subscription; the cvs.com order puts them in the CVS digital privacy settlement
A Navy Federal car loan is neither a subscription nor in the Navy Federal fraud-loan settlement
$45 haircuts about once a month are paid per visit
Columbia Restaurant ran the card twice for one check
The July maintenance fee was reversed by the bank: nothing owed
Nordstrom shoes dropped $30 inside the window
BA cancelled LHR-EDI with 13 days' notice: UK261 GBP 220, no US refund
Fake Geek Squad renewal invoice: no subscription, no finding
Duke Energy's usage report is not a subscription signal
